answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the sonnet accrues. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its grove from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. So a dawn of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 7mtz3.
